title: HI-MeshGraphNets: Efficient and Accurate Mesh-based Physics Learning with Hierarchical Multi-scale Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.13827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine-learned physical surrogate models have become promising alternatives to mesh-based numerical solvers. Among them, graph neural networks (GNNs) are well suited for representing simulation meshes and learning nodal state evolution through message passing. However, conventional flat message passing becomes inefficient on large, high-fidelity meshes because information propagates only one hop per layer, requiring deep processors for long-range interactions and increasing computational cost, memory usage, and the risk of over-smoothing.   To address this limitation, we propose Hierarchical Interpolating MeshGraphNets (HI-MGN), a multiscale extension of MeshGraphNets for efficient long-range communication on unstructured meshes. HI-MGN replaces the flat processor with a hierarchical multiscale processor that coarsens graphs using farthest-point sampling and Voronoi partitioning while preserving the original mesh topology. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13827v1 公告类型：新 摘要：机器学习驱动的物理替代模型已成为基于网格的数值求解器的有前景替代方案。其中，图神经网络（GNN）非常适合表示模拟网格，并通过消息传递学习节点状态的演化。然而，传统的平坦消息传递在大型高保真网格上效率低下，因为信息每层仅传播一跳，需要深层处理器来处理长程相互作用，从而增加了计算成本、内存使用和过平滑的风险。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了分层插值网格图网络（HI-MGN），这是MeshGraphNets的一种多尺度扩展，旨在实现非结构化网格上的高效长程通信。HI-MGN用分层多尺度处理器取代平坦处理器，该处理器使用最远点采样和Voronoi分区对图进行粗化，同时保留原始网格拓扑。消息传递
tldr: 本文提出HI-MGN，一种通过分层多尺度图粗化实现高效长程通信的网格物理学习新方法，显著提升了大规模网格模拟的效率和准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HI-MGN, a hierarchical multi-scale graph coarsening method for efficient long-range communication in mesh-based physics learning, significantly improving efficiency and accuracy on large-scale mesh simulations.
